bio_en: Armenak Okhikian, known as Slak and also as 'Bzhishk' (doctor) - a name often given to educated revolutionaries - was an ARF activist in Bitlis. He was a delegate to the ARF's 8th General Congress held in Karin (Erzurum) from 15 to 30 July 1914, which was interrupted by the outbreak of the First World War. In 1915, after Jevdet bey's defeat at Van, the governor disarmed the Armenians of Bitlis and organised their massacre. Okhikian was killed in the Bitlis massacre.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium.
